==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this skill with two considerations:
** They will use it to as a generic heal.
** They will use it to remove conditions if any spirits are in earshot, even if the target has not taken damage.

==Notes==
* Within earshot of the caster, not target.
* Because of the short recharge time, low energy cost and ability to remove multiple conditions, this skill can in some cases, such as when you have a [[spirit spammer]] in your party, be an excellent condition removal. This can make the skill very effective even at 0 Restoration Magic.
{{anomaly|While most other ally targeted Restoration Magic spells cast a unique visual effect on the target, Mend Body and Soul places a unique visual effect on the caster instead.}}
